boot_rom.basis: The X-T3's own boot ROM window 0xfff00000..0xfff08000, read from the camera over FF80, is byte-identical to the X100V capture the registry resolves (research/xt3-511/sd-boot.md, 'Boot ROM read from the X-T3', 2026-11-10).

boot_strap.basis: boot_source_select selects the SD card when bits 0x18 of the word are clear (the X-T3's rear dial press with Fn1 at power-on) and otherwise serial-flash mode (word & 7) + 1; 0x18 is mode 1, the mode stage one is read with. The strap's other bits are unmeasured.

last_write_banks.basis: Words above the GPIO model that the card's first stage (ffinit, its hardware setup script) writes; their meanings are not decoded.
A page ffinit's hardware setup script writes that no model owns; its meaning is not decoded.
Pages ffinit's first-stage DRAM and clock setup writes, found by declaring one page per refused access; meanings unmeasured.
As 0xff400000. The still DSP window at 0xff482000 lies inside the following range and stays its own device.
As 0xff480000, the part above the still DSP window.

fixed_words.basis: Words +0x44c and +0x620 of each DDR channel block read 0x00010001: the first-stage DRAM setup requires both 11-bit fields (bits 10:0 and 26:16) of each to be nonzero as its training result. These are the smallest values that pass; the real training results are unmeasured.

power_inputs.basis: Power controller register 16 is the cold boot reason the stock loader copies into its handoff block, which the X-T3 run configuration declares as 4. Reason 4 is a declared cold-start input, not a capture from a camera. (The loader reads it at 0x850..0x860 and stores it at handoff +0x140.)
